catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alvarez-caril: A 1913 entry on Cardinal Albornoz — the warrior who won back the Papal States. Michael Ott honors his iron statesmanship. His Egidian Constitutions ruled for centuries. Spain's greatest son in red. The papacy's sword in Italy. His college at Bologna still stands.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-badajoz: This 1913 reference article on Badajoz — the Spanish diocese of the Guadiana. Tirso López Bardón gives its story. Its bishops date from antiquity. The Alcazaba crowns the border town. A see of the Extremaduran plain. Its bridge spans the Guadiana's width.
